# Bayesian Linear Regression - Coral Bleaching 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# upload packages
library(brms)
```

```{r}
# load in data
coral <- read.csv("/Users/arshia.mathur/Downloads/global_bleaching_environmental.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(coral)
dim(coral)
```
```{r}
# Data Cleaning
# replace all "nd" with NA so R knows there's missing data
coral[coral == "nd"] <- NA

# extract 9 features + target feature (Percent_Bleaching) from MLP
# coerce to numeric data

features <- c("TSA", "TSA_DHW", "SSTA", "ClimSST",
              "Windspeed", "Turbidity", "Cyclone_Frequency",
              "Distance_to_Shore", "Depth_m", "Percent_Bleaching")

coral_sub <- as.data.frame(lapply(coral[, features], as.numeric))

# drop rows where Percent_Bleaching is NA 
coral_sub <- coral_sub[!is.na(coral_sub$Percent_Bleaching), ]

# drop rows with any NAs remaining in the 9 features
coral_sub <- coral_sub[complete.cases(coral_sub), ]
dim(coral_sub)
summary(coral_sub$Percent_Bleaching)

# standardize 9 features using same preprocessing as the MLP
feature_cols <- c("TSA", "TSA_DHW", "SSTA", "ClimSST",
                  "Windspeed", "Turbidity", "Cyclone_Frequency",
                  "Distance_to_Shore", "Depth_m")
coral_scaled <- coral_sub
coral_scaled[, feature_cols] <- scale(coral_sub[, feature_cols])
head(coral_scaled)
```
```{r}
# train/test split: 70% train, 30% test
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(coral_scaled)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, size = floor(0.70 * n))
train_data <- coral_scaled[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- coral_scaled[-train_idx, ]
 
# subsample training data (data is too large) to 5000 rows
set.seed(42)
train_sample <- train_data[sample(nrow(train_data), 5000), ]

# check what default priors look like first
default_prior(Percent_Bleaching ~ TSA + TSA_DHW + SSTA + ClimSST +
Windspeed + Turbidity + Cyclone_Frequency + Distance_to_Shore + Depth_m, data = train_sample, family = gaussian)
```
```{r}
# manual priors; student_t on intercept (fatter tails given the skew in Percent_Bleaching),
# normal(0, 10) on slopes; features are standardized and bleaching is 0-100 so a coefficient of 10 would mean a 1 SD change in a stressor shifts bleaching by 10 percentage points,
manual_prior <- c(prior(student_t(3, 0, 10), class = "Intercept"),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'TSA'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'TSA_DHW'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'SSTA'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'ClimSST'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'Windspeed'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'Turbidity'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'Cyclone_Frequency'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'Distance_to_Shore'),
                  prior(normal(0, 10), class = 'b', coef = 'Depth_m'))
```

```{r}
# fit the Bayesian linear regression
# gaussian() since Percent_Bleaching is a continuous outcome
coral_brm <- brm(Percent_Bleaching ~ TSA + TSA_DHW + SSTA + ClimSST +
                   Windspeed + Turbidity + Cyclone_Frequency +
                   Distance_to_Shore + Depth_m,
                 family = gaussian(),
                 data = train_sample,
                 prior = manual_prior,
                 chains = 4,
                 cores = getOption("mc.cores", 4),
                 iter = 2000,
                 warmup = 1000,
                 thin = 2,
                 seed = 42)
```

```{r}
summary(coral_brm)
 
# trace plots and posterior histograms to check convergence and mixing
plot(coral_brm)
```

```{r}
# Bayesian R^2

bayes_R2(coral_brm)
```

```{r}
# posterior predictive distribution on the test set
post_preds <- posterior_predict(coral_brm, newdata = test_data)
head(post_preds[, 1:10]) # each row is an MCMC draw, each column is a reef site
```
```{r}
# compare posterior predictive means to actual bleaching values
pred_means <- colMeans(post_preds)
cor(pred_means, test_data$Percent_Bleaching)
plot(pred_means, test_data$Percent_Bleaching,
     xlab = "Posterior Predictive Mean", ylab = "Actual Percent Bleaching",
     main = "Posterior Predictive Means vs. Actual Bleaching")
abline(0, 1, col = 'red', lwd = 2)
```
```{r}
# RMSE
rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred_means - test_data$Percent_Bleaching)^2))
rmse
```

```{r}
# conditional effects: marginal effect of each stressor holding all others at their mean
library(ggplot2)
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "TSA"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "Turbidity"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "Cyclone_Frequency"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "ClimSST"))[[1]]
```

```{r}
# posterior predictive distribution for a specific reef site
# representing a high thermal stress, low turbidity open water site
new_reef <- data.frame(
  TSA               = (2.0  - mean(coral_sub$TSA))               / sd(coral_sub$TSA),
  TSA_DHW           = (5.0  - mean(coral_sub$TSA_DHW))           / sd(coral_sub$TSA_DHW),
  SSTA              = (1.5  - mean(coral_sub$SSTA))              / sd(coral_sub$SSTA),
  ClimSST           = (28.0 - mean(coral_sub$ClimSST))           / sd(coral_sub$ClimSST),
  Windspeed         = (4.0  - mean(coral_sub$Windspeed))         / sd(coral_sub$Windspeed),
  Turbidity         = (0.05 - mean(coral_sub$Turbidity))         / sd(coral_sub$Turbidity),
  Cyclone_Frequency = (0.1  - mean(coral_sub$Cyclone_Frequency)) / sd(coral_sub$Cyclone_Frequency),
  Distance_to_Shore = (15.0 - mean(coral_sub$Distance_to_Shore)) / sd(coral_sub$Distance_to_Shore),
  Depth_m           = (5.0  - mean(coral_sub$Depth_m))           / sd(coral_sub$Depth_m)
)
 
reef_preds <- posterior_predict(coral_brm, newdata = new_reef)
hist(reef_preds, breaks = 40,
     main = "Posterior Predictive Distribution - High Thermal Stress Site",
     xlab = "Predicted Percent Bleaching")
abline(v = mean(reef_preds), col = 'red', lwd = 2, lty = 2)
mean(reef_preds)
# 95% credible interval for this site's predicted bleaching
quantile(reef_preds, c(0.025, 0.975))
```
